summary: Sprint 3 (MongoDB backbone + light-luxury visual refinement) fully verified. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass — health returns status=ok, service=azuris-platform, version=0.1.0, sprint=3, environment=development, database=connected (live Motor ping). BaseRepository imports cleanly and exposes find_one/find_many/count/insert_one/update_one/soft_delete. `python -m scripts.init_db` runs successfully twice in a row (idempotent) and prints an index summary containing all 14 locked collections. Frontend: /, /catalog/gemstones, /login all render on the refined light theme with 0 console errors. Bilingual ID/EN toggle works via language-option-en / language-option-id data-testids.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown — consider migrating to lifespan context manager in a later sprint (not blocking).
MongoManager.connect() has no retry/backoff; single-attempt ping with 5s serverSelectionTimeoutMS. Fine for dev, but production should add retry/backoff (planned in later sprints).
Startup swallows DB init exceptions with a broad except (intentional per comment 'never block boot') — health endpoint will then return degraded, which is correct behavior.
seed_data_creation: None. init_db creates indexes only, no documents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 3 baseline is green. Health returns sprint=3 with database=connected. All 14 collections indexed. BaseRepository foundation exists but is intentionally not wired to any endpoint. When Sprint 4 lands, update the health/sprint assertion in test_health.py and test_sprint3_db.py accordingly, and add tests for the new domain models/repos as they land.
